title: Quantitative stratification and global regularity for 1/2-harmonic mappings
summary: In this paper, we extend the celebrated global regularity theory of Naber-Valtorta [Ann. Math. 2017] to 1/2-harmonic mappings into manifolds. Inspired by their work, we first adapt Lin's defect measure theory [Ann. Math. 1999] to such maps building on the partial regularity established by Millot-Pegon-Schikorra [Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 2021]. Then apply it to show that the set of singular points of such maps can be quantitatively stratified via a new notion of boundary symmetry with the aid of {the celebrated harmonic extension method by Caffarelli-Silverstre}.
